cases.sentence: Зачем возмущаются ___, и язычники замышляют пустое?
cases.explain: Народы is the subject of the verb возмущаются (rage), taking the nominative case.

cases.sentence: Восстают земные ___, и правители собираются вместе.
cases.explain: Цари is the plural nominative subject of the verb восстают (take a stand).
The preposition против (against) always governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Цепи их разорвем, говорят, оковы их сбросим ___ себя.
cases.explain: The preposition от (from) governs the genitive case to show source or separation.

cases.sentence: Восседающий на небесах смеется, ___ насмехается над ними.
cases.explain: Владыка is the subject of the verb насмехается (has in derision), taking the nominative case.

cases.sentence: Я поставил ___ своего над Сионом, моей святой горой.
cases.explain: Царя is the direct object of the transitive verb поставил (set), requiring the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Отдам ___ тебе в наследие, края земли тебе во владение.
cases.explain: Народы is the direct object of the verb отдам (I will give), requiring the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Целуйте ___, чтобы он не разгневался, и вы не погибли.
cases.explain: Сына is the direct object of the transitive verb целуйте (honor), requiring the accusative case.

reading.ru: Зачем возмущаются народы, и язычники замышляют пустое?
reading.question: What is the opening question of this psalm?
options: Why do the nations rage and peoples plot vain things?
Why does God abandon His people?
reading.correct: Why do the nations rage and peoples plot vain things?
reading.explain: The psalm opens with this rhetorical question about the futile rebellion of nations against God.

reading.ru: Восстают земные цари, и правители собираются вместе против Господа и против его помазанника.
reading.question: Against whom do the kings and rulers gather in rebellion?
reading.explain: The kings and rulers conspire against the Lord and His Anointed.

reading.ru: Цепи их разорвем, говорят, оковы их сбросим.
reading.question: What do the rebels declare they will do?
options: Break their bonds apart and cast off their cords
reading.correct: Break their bonds apart and cast off their cords
reading.explain: The rebels declare they will break free from divine authority, attempting to assert their independence.

reading.ru: Восседающий на небесах смеется, владыка насмехается над ними.
reading.question: What is God's response to the rebellion of the nations?
options: He sits in heaven and laughs; the Lord has them in derision
He is troubled and sends immediate armies
reading.correct: He sits in heaven and laughs; the Lord has them in derision
reading.explain: God's response demonstrates His complete sovereignty—He finds the rebellion laughable and futile.

reading.ru: Я поставил царя своего над Сионом, моей святой горой.
reading.question: What has God established despite the rebellion of the nations?
options: God has set His King on His holy hill of Zion
reading.correct: God has set His King on His holy hill of Zion
reading.explain: Even as nations rebel, God's King reigns secure on Zion, God's holy mountain.

reading.ru: Целуйте сына, чтобы он не разгневался, и вы не погибли в пути, потому что гнев его быстро вспыхивает.
reading.question: What urgent warning does the psalm conclude with?
options: All rulers must honor the Son or face swift destruction from His wrath
The Son will never punish anyone
Worship is optional for all people
God's anger develops slowly over time
reading.correct: All rulers must honor the Son or face swift destruction from His wrath
reading.explain: The psalm's conclusion warns that resistance to God's Son brings certain judgment from His quickly kindled wrath.
